subject: Re: Saturday prep block
text: I checked the shared calendar again and realized I misread the entry: the community hall block is Saturday at ten, not Sunday at noon, so the current reminder I sent is wrong. Please treat this as the corrected time and update your notes before Saturday evening. That means we load the tables and folding chairs at nine, not after lunch, and the paint samples must be brought with the cart rather than left for later. The venue only releases the room for forty-five minutes before the class starts, so lateness will force us to scramble without the extra tablecloths. If you have already arranged transport for Sunday, let me know soon and we can shift one crate without making anyone drive twice. I am also leaving the key with the hall caretaker, who expects a quick count of equipment before he signs off. Do not wait until morning to send your shopping list, because the shop may close early. If I have still missed anything else, reply now while we can adjust the plan. Thanks for catching the earlier confusion.
